N.S.Shekhawat J. (Oral)
Crm-43757-2023
Application is allowed, as prayed for, subject to just exceptions.
Annexures P-4 to P-9 are taken on record.

The petitioner has filed the instant petition under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
with a prayer to grant anticipatory bail to him in case FIR No.366 dated 10.06.2022 registered under Sections 406, 420 of IPC, at Police Station Panipat City, Panipat.

In compliance of the last order dated 13.10.2023, learned counsel for the petitioner has handed over four demand drafts bearing Nos.004578 dated 02.11.2023 for a sum of Rs.2,55,000/-, 004065 dated 21.10.2023 for a sum of 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:145870 CRM-M-49674-2022 -2- 2023:PHHC:145870 Rs.2,45,000/-, 000410 dated 13.11.2023 for a sum of Rs.2,55,000/- and 004064 dated 21.10.2023, for a sum of Rs.2,45,000/- to the learned Senior counsel appearing on behalf of the complainant.
Photocopy of the same be marked as 'A'.

sentences.text: 1 petitioner submits that in compliance of the order dated 28.10.2022, passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court, the petitioner has joined the investigation.
Learned counsel for the State has submitted that the petitioner has joined the investigation and is no longer required for further investigation.
In view of the statement made by learned State counsel, the interim order dated 28.10.2023, passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, is made absolute.

The petitioner shall continue to join investigation, as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall also abide by the conditions as provided under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
 (N.S.SHEKHAWAT)
